stem: Boy pulls cup of coffee over him. Mom calls you (GP), has put butter on burn. What is the best mx?

options.text: Take off clothes, run cold water over 5-10mins
Take off clothes, cold water 20 mins
Call ambo, and you’ll notify ED they’re coming in
